Password policy requires minimum 12 characters.
Only admins may access the production database.
Two-factor authentication is required for all users.
Role-based access control is enforced for all services.
Data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256.
GDPR compliance requires data retention limits.
Backup policy mandates weekly full backups and daily incrementals.
Network traffic is monitored and logged for security incidents.
Password policy was updated in 2024 to enforce complexity rules.
User accounts are locked after 5 failed login attempts.
All API keys must be rotated every 90 days.

Access to production systems requires VPN connection.
Personal data must not be stored in application logs.
Firewall rules are reviewed quarterly by the security team.
Only authorized personnel may modify access control lists.
Incident response plan must be tested annually.
Development environments must not use production data.
All software dependencies must be scanned for vulnerabilities.
Remote access requires certificate-based authentication.
